findings.message: Points at localhost: it only works on the developer machine
findings.fix: Make sure release builds use production URLs (check env-based config such as EXPO_PUBLIC_* or app.config.ts). If this host is intended, add it to allowHosts in release-lint.config.json.

findings.message: Plain HTTP is allowed for a development host. Points at localhost: it only works on the developer machine
findings.fix: Remove this host from NSAppTransportSecurity → NSExceptionDomains for release builds (in Expo: ios.infoPlist in app.config). App Review asks for a reason for every exception.

findings.message: App Transport Security is turned off for every host
findings.fix: Remove NSAllowsArbitraryLoads, or use NSExceptionDomains for the few hosts that need it. App Review asks for a reason.
